Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.ai

Class WikiResponseParser

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.ai.WikiResponseParser
public class WikiResponseParser extends Object
Parses the structured LLM response from the wiki compilation prompt into domain records (WikiPage, Contradiction, warnings).

The parser splits the raw response by section headers (### PAGE:, ### CONTRADICTION:, ### WARNING:) and extracts field values from each section. Malformed sections are logged at WARN level and skipped — the compilation continues with whatever was successfully parsed.

This class has no Spring dependencies and can be unit-tested without a Spring context.
